news.summary: A contribuição substituirá PIS e Cofins; piloto permite que empresas experimentem sistemas para implementação do tributo

news.title: Iran threatens response to any attack amid naval blockade
news.summary: Iran threatens response to any attack amid naval blockade

news.title: Search continues for dozens missing after Indonesia candy factory fire
news.summary: Rescuers are searching for around 30 missing workers after a candy factory fire killed at least 24 people in Banten.

news.title: Anvisa proíbe venda de xampu sem autorização para uso infantil
news.summary: Segundo a agência, produto anticaspa em barra era fabricado com rótulo que indicava uso para crianças sem aval necessário

news.title: Photographer Federico Veronesi: 'I've been in love with African wildlife since I was three'
news.summary: The winner of this year's Wildlife Photographer of the Year award has told FRANCE 24 that his winning picture reveals a lot about the complexity of an elephant's soul and feelings. At first glance the image seems to show a mother elephant playing with her calf, but in fact it is a female carrying another elephant's dead calf. Photographer Federico Veronesi told us how he fell in love in Kenya as a six-year-old child and ended up moving there to fulfil his photography dream. He spoke to us in Perspective.

news.title: Rússia pretende posicionar bomba atômica no espaço neste ano, diz imprensa alemã
news.summary: Reportagem da imprensa alemã se baseia em informações de militares e agências de inteligência do Ocidente. Ogiva nuclear seria lançada dentro de satélite ainda neste ano.

news.title: 'Out of control': ICE agents make arrests at Seattle airport in 'horrific' scene
news.summary: The governor of Washington state called US federal immigration agents "out of control" after they arrested two people at Seattle's main airport on Saturday. ICE officers have conducted raids across the United States, part of President Donald Trump's immigration crackdown which has forged ahead despite a rebuke by voters at this month's midterms.

news.title: Apenas 7% das mulheres sobreviventes de violência vão à polícia, diz ONU
news.summary: Relatório da ONU Mulheres mostra que baixa notificação se baseia em falhas do sistema de justiça desde a queixa ao julgamento; em todo o mundo quase 1 em cada 3 mulheres ou meninas é vítima de agressões ao longo da vida.

news.title: Falhas tecnológicas e ataques cibernéticos reforçam apelo por IA mais segura
news.summary: Cúpula da ONU sobre Segurança em Inteligência Artificial busca soluções para que todos os países consigam gerenciar riscos; líder das Nações Unidas defendeu criação de estrutura multilateral com supervisão independente.

news.title: Migração pela região de Darién cai 90%, mas novas rotas sobem na América do Sul
news.summary: Pela primeira vez, agência da ONU identifica a "Rota do Leste da América do Sul" como corredor migratório plenamente estabelecido, que se estende do Caribe, passando pelo norte da América do Sul, até o Brasil e o Cone Sul; muitos migrantes estão voltando à casa ou se estabelecendo em países como Brasil e Uruguai.

news.title: Agência investe US$ 52 milhões para que 300 mil crianças possam estudar
news.summary: Iniciativa Educação Não Pode Esperar busca beneficiar escolas no Líbano, em Mianmar e no Sudão do Sul e destaca que, em crises, estudar protege vidas; ainda faltam US$ 58 milhões para alcançar países como o Afeganistão.

news.title: Al menos tres muertos en un ataque de Rusia contra una clínica de Zaporiyia, en el sureste de Ucrania
news.summary: Las autoridades de Ucrania han informado este lunes de que al menos tres personas han muerto y una cuarta ha resultado herida a causa de un ataque perpetrado por el Ejército de Rusia contra una clínica de Zaporiyia, parcialmente ocupada por Rusia y situada en el sureste de Ucrania.

news.title: Inside the talks between student protest leaders and Macron’s government
news.summary: Al Jazeera interviews two French student leaders who have met with top government officials as protests continue.

news.title: Negociação de Eisenkot com partido de Netanyahu não avança
news.summary: Representantes do Yashar e do Likud se reuniram por 4 horas; discutiram “questões centrais”, mas não trataram de quem seria premiê

news.title: ‘Fighting for love’: Thousands turn out for Rio Pride parade
news.summary: Thousands of people flocked to Copacabana Beach in Rio Sunday for the 31st annual Pride Parade. The event marked 15 years since Brazil's Supreme Court unanimously recognized same sex unions. Ophelie Jacobson explains what the celebration means for the LGBT community this year.

news.title: Thousands protest Turkey media crackdown in Istanbul
news.summary: Several thousand people marched through Istanbul on Sunday to protest a growing crackdown on opposition and independent media outlets days after police raided pro-opposition broadcaster Sozcu TV, installing a government-appointed trustee and arresting senior staff members.

news.title: Las autoridades de Gaza denuncian la muerte de un niño a causa de "envenenamiento por plomo" en la Franja
news.summary: Las autoridades de la Franja de Gaza, controladas por el Movimiento de Resistencia Islámica (Hamás), han denunciado este lunes la muerte de un niño a causa de "envenenamiento por plomo", en medio de las denuncias por parte de organizaciones no gubernamentales sobre la elevada contaminación ambiental en el enclave a causa de la ofensiva lanzada por Israel tras los ataques del 7 de octubre de 2023.

news.title: Governo federal libera R$ 4,7 milhões para Tupanciretã (RS)
news.summary: Recursos serão destinados à compra de alimentos, kits de higiene e colchões para atender moradores afetados pela tempestade

news.title: Partido italiano propõe taxa de 5% sobre ingressos para bancar segurança
news.summary: Emenda ao Orçamento de 2027 estabelece que clubes profissionais financiem horas extras e adicionais de policiais

news.title: Mercado eleva projeção de inflação para 5,15% em 2026
news.summary: Boletim Focus aumenta estimativa do dólar; projeção para a Selic se mantém inalterada e a do PIB recua

news.title: El Kremlin "toma nota" de la reivindicación de Zelenski sobre el ataque contra una corbeta de Rusia en Libia
news.summary: Las autoridades de Rusia han asegurado este lunes que "toman nota" de la reivindicación por parte del presidente de Ucrania, Volodimir Zelenski, de la autoría del ataque perpetrado el domingo contra una corbeta rusa anclada en el puerto de Benghazi, en el este de Libia, declinando hacer más comentarios sobre los daños sufridos por el buque, que habría quedado parcialmente sumergido.

news.title: Former Icelandic PM says world’s great powers are flexing their muscles
news.summary: Iceland’s former PM warns climate change remains an existential threat as global power politics sidelines action.

news.title: Como foi captura de narcotraficante mexicano na lista dos 10 mais procurados do FBI
news.summary: Fausto Isidro 'Chapo Idisro' Meza Flores, acusado de tráfico de drogas e tortura, foi detido em operação conduzida por forças especiais com participação do Exército que deixou pelo menos 11 mortos.

news.title: COP31: What next after UN climate talks collapse
news.summary: UN member states fail to agree on how to fast-track action to reverse global warming in a blow to climate agenda.

news.title: Ukraine claims drone strikes on Russian ships off Libya: What do we know?
news.summary: Drone strikes on two Russian vessels near Libyan coast fuels fears of Ukraine war's spread.

news.title: German police respond to multiple school bomb threats
news.summary: Police in Germany are responding to bomb threats against a series of schools, but say that at present they don't believe them to be credible. Danish authorities are reporting a similar series of apparent hoaxes.

news.title: Lebanese families return to ruins after Israeli attacks in south
news.summary: In southern Lebanon’s Nabatieh, displaced families have been returning to ruins and widespread destruction.

news.title: CAS decision on Senegal’s AFCON 2025 title appeal on Tuesday
news.summary: Senegal are contesting CAF's decision to declare Morocco champions, despite Senegal winning the final 1-0 in January.

news.title: Há 200 anos, Brasil se comprometia a acabar com o 'tráfico negreiro' — só 'para inglês ver'
news.summary: Há 200 anos, em 23 de novembro de 1826, os governos britânico e brasileiro assinaram um acordo que estipulava o fim do tráfico transatlântico de africanos escravizados para o Brasil; mas, na prática, nada mudou.

news.title: Papers discuss James Bond's soft power and the next Bond girl
news.summary: PRESS REVIEW – Monday, November 23: Papers react to the breakdown of the COP31 climate talks. Israeli paper Haaretz reports on the struggles of crossing the Qalandiyah checkpoint. The New York Times talks about the mathematical "formula to stop the apocalypse". Finally, the Bond universe keeps making headlines.

news.title: Ucrânia corre contra o tempo para encontrar sobreviventes de ataque russo a prédio residencial
news.summary: Socorristas vasculham escombros de edifício atingido por bombardeio. Idosa é resgatada após 22 horas. Moscou atacou diversas localidades civis na região de Kiev no fim de semana.

news.title: Alice Huang had contact with China spy agency during affair with Nvidia boss, New York Times reports
news.summary: Alice Huang, who is alleged to have been spying for Chinese intelligence during her affair with former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, was in contact with China's Ministry of State Security until autumn 2026, the New York Times reported Monday, citing people with knowledge of US intelligence reports.

news.title: Cate Blanchett lights up Champs-Élysées as Christmas market returns
news.summary: Australian actress Cate Blanchett joined Paris's mayor for the official switch on of the Christmas lights along the Champs-Élysées on Sunday. This year also sees the return of a Christmas market on the famous Paris avenue for the first time in nearly 10 years.

news.title: 'Out of control': ICE arrests at Seattle airport spark outcry
news.summary: A father and daughter detained by masked ICE officers on an airport jet bridge in Seattle has sparked a renewed outcry over the Trump administration’s immigration policies, with the governor of Washington state calling US federal immigration agents "out of control". Other passengers boarding the Alaska Airlines flight at Seattle-Tacoma International Airport on Saturday used their cellphones to film the father and daughter being detained by the officers, who were wearing unmarked jackets and khaki pants. The recordings were widely viewed on social media.

news.title: The worst COP ever? Climate talks collapse in chaos
news.summary: The COP31 climate talks ended in failure Sunday as a contentious deal collapsed over fossil fuels and the summit in Turkey stretched into record overtime. The final agreement was rejected in a chaotic finale to a UN climate summit that ran two days over schedule, underscoring the strains on diplomacy in an increasingly fractured world. France 24’s Douglas Herbert takes a look at whether the failure to reach an agreement makes COP31 the most disappointing climate summit to date.

news.title: Why is Bangladesh’s Grameen Bank under attack?
news.summary: Leading financial institution has found itself at centre of tensions amid violence by Sheikh Hasina supporters.

news.title: Occupied West Bank ‘military zones’ become de facto Israeli settler land
news.summary: Closed military zones in the occupied West Bank are being seized by settlers as staging posts for pogroms.

news.title: Ukraine-Russia peace talks: Row over who will represent the EU
news.summary: As Russia and Ukraine continue to trade strikes a row is erupting over who Europe should send to any future peace talks with the two countries along with the US. The EU's High Representative for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy Kaja Kallas is being squeezed out in favour of foreign ministers of five of Europe's major countries, a sign, says France 24’s correspondent Dave Keating, that the EU still lacks a common foreign policy.

news.title: Zelenskyy hails Ukraine's attack on a Russian warship docked at a naval base in Libya
news.summary: Ukraine carried out an attack on a Russian warship moored at a port in Libya, President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said, claiming that sea drones sank the navy vessel in a surprise assault.

news.title: Ukrainian drones hit a Russian warship at a naval base in Libya, Zelenskyy says
news.summary: Ukraine carried out an attack on a Russian warship moored at a port in Libya, President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said, claiming that sea drones sank the navy vessel in a surprise assault.

news.title: Odesa pupils switch to remote learning as Russia pounds Ukraine’s energy grid
news.summary: Schools in Odesa will switch to remote teaching after Russian strikes gravely damaged the energy grid in the major Ukrainian Black Sea port city. Russia has carried out a wide-ranging campaign of strikes against Ukraine's energy infrastructure, with the prospect of another freezing wartime winter looming.

news.title: Thousands displaced after deadly storm hits Brazil town
news.summary: A powerful supercell storm devastated the Brazilian town of Tupancireta.

news.title: Zelensky says Ukraine sank Russian warship off Libya
news.summary: President Volodymyr Zelensky has confirmed that Ukraine was behind the sinking of a ⁠Russian naval corvette in a Libyan port on Sunday in an attack involving seven naval drones. Zelensky said Ukraine also struck a Russian cargo ship the MV Angara, which he said Russia had ⁠used to transport weapons.

news.title: 'Let down on all sides': Pacific island nations express despair over COP31 failure
news.summary: Several Pacific island nations expressed despair and disappointment Monday over the failure of the UN climate talks to reach a final agreement on tackling the climate crisis. Small nations in the Pacific are among the world's most vulnerable to the rising sea levels brought on my man-made global warming.
